verdict.rationale: AnyDesk documents an official CLI for scripted installation, configuration, connection, and silent removal without user interaction, usable with deployment tools and batch scripts (anydesk-docs-1, anydesk-docs-2, anydesk-docs-3, anydesk-docs-4, anydesk-docs-5). It also offers a REST API and a Python module for automating session and client data tasks (anydesk-docs-8, anydesk-docs-10, anydesk-docs-12). This is deployment and admin automation, though, not documented headless operation of the remote-desktop product inside CI pipelines. Missing for 10: explicit headless or no-GUI runtime mode, documented CI pipeline usage, and independent or hands-on corroboration of unattended automation.
